credits: Original pixel art for Verdant Reach, hand-built in tools/art/species_f/ (Round 4). Subject: Malus domestica (orchard apple); drawn from its botany, not traced from any photo.

source.from: base art before the Crystal-rule rollout

notes: LUNGING: a whip trunk in a C, a king blossom for a head, its first apple held out on the lead twig like a fist. Accent: the wine apple skin (dark slot). Sport: Malus 'Royalty' (purple-leaved crabapple: bronze-purple leaves, crimson-pink blossom, dark fruit).
